description: Replaces the workflow's draft: send the draft from get_workflow, edited (name, targets with their mappings, policy: resolve_confidence, gate). The published version is untouched until publish_workflow. Which documents get in: policy.gate = {accept: [one choice], on_mismatch, when_unsure}; leave gate out to let every document in. accept: "insurance" (any insurance document); one kind: "policy" (policies, quotes, binders, endorsements), "submission" (applications, loss runs, schedules), "claims", "certificate" (certificates and evidence of insurance), "billing" (invoices, premium audits); or one type of page: "declarations", "loss_run", "application", "certificate_of_insurance". on_mismatch, for a document that is clearly something else: "reject" (refuse it; default) or "warn" (read it anyway, with a warning). when_unsure: "extract" (read it, with a warning; default) or "reject". A refused document costs only the check and is not an extraction; job status "rejected", result.rejected.reason says why. It filters out documents that don't belong; it is not a security control.
